Third-party browser libraries served by the ground station itself, so the dashboard works without internet
(only the map background tiles are fetched from the network). Unmodified upstream files.

  leaflet.js, leaflet.css, images/   Leaflet 1.9.4            BSD-2-Clause   https://leafletjs.com
  leaflet-heat.js                    Leaflet.heat 0.2.0       BSD-2-Clause   https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet.heat
  chart.umd.js                       Chart.js 4.4.1           MIT            https://www.chartjs.org
  three.module.js, OrbitControls.js  three.js r160            MIT            https://threejs.org
  PressStart2P.woff2                 Press Start 2P (latin)   SIL OFL 1.1    https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Press+Start+2P
  VT323.woff2                        VT323 (latin)            SIL OFL 1.1    https://fonts.google.com/specimen/VT323

fonts.css is written by this project and only declares the two fonts above.
